lines.en: I crawl over the leaf.
I creep along the twig.

lines.zh: 我从叶尖跳到下一片叶上。
lines.en: I hop from a leaf tip to the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我的身体和叶子一个色
lines.en: My body matches the leaf.
I work my way to the leaf's edge.
I slip under the leaf.
I push forward segment by segment.
I crawl over the raised vein.
I creep a little further.
I circle on the leaf.
I try to cross at the tip.
I move flat along the leaf.
I slip through the leaf gap.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉，慢慢爬回叶心。
lines.en: I crawl along the vein back to the leaf's heart.
I climb the stem.
I stop on the vein again.
I inch toward the tip.
I creep along the underside.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶子上一动不动
lines.en: I lie on the leaf without moving.
You cannot tell me from the leaf.
I stretch and shrink a little.
I press myself flatter.
I rest beside the vein.
I slowly reach out.
The leaf moves with the wind.

lines.zh: 我和这里的枝叶没两样。
lines.en: I look no different from these twigs.
I look up at the light.
I bask on the leaf.
I lie on the leaf and do not shift.
I spread myself out again.
I show my head out of the leaves.

lines.zh: 我和叶子一个颜色，你看不见。
lines.en: I am the same green as the leaf; you cannot see me.
I shrink and dare not move.
I shrink back under the leaf.
I am as green as the leaf.

lines.zh: 我是叶子做的虫，你看漏了吧。
lines.en: A bug made of leaves; you missed me.
I retreat toward the stem.
I lie on the leaf, waiting for you to leave.
My legs are fine as thread.
I press to the vein and hold.
I roll off the leaf.
I curl into a ball.
One of my segments goes numb.

lines.zh: 我贴在叶背，连触角都不动。
lines.en: I press to the leaf's underside, antennae still.
I spit a little green fluid.
I slowly uncurl.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还抓着叶脉。
lines.en: One leg is broken, yet I still grip the vein.
I am still trembling.
I cannot move.
I hide in the leaf.
There is something on the leaf.
I creep at it segment by segment.
I touch it once.
I hardly dare eat it.
This does not look like leaf.
I go around it.
I will stick to leaves.
I retreat to the vein.
I look at it once more.
I simply ignore it.
Your touch rolls me over.
I grab the vein at once.

lines.zh: 叶子一翻，我的细腿抓紧叶缘。
lines.en: The leaf tips, and my thin legs grip its edge.
I crawl back onto the leaf.
The jolt presses me flat.
I dare not move for a while.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我抓紧叶脉不放。
lines.en: You brush the leaf, and I cling to its veins.
I tuck into the leaf's middle.

lines.zh: 我被撞得卷起来，又慢慢展开。
lines.en: The bump curls me up; I slowly unroll.
I am still here.
I creep half a step toward the leaf's heart.
I set my legs again.
Another creeps over.
Our bodies touch.
It is green as the leaf too.
We crawl toward the vein together.
It is shorter than I.
Neither of us makes a sound.
It climbs above me.
We stop at the leaf's heart.
It moves first.
I hump along after it.
I bite off a bit of leaf.
I chew slowly.
I chew off another little piece.

lines.zh: 我啃出一个洞，钻了过去。
lines.en: I chew a hole and crawl through it.
I poke my head through it.
I crawl to another leaf.
I grip the new leaf's edge.
I return to the vein.
I stop in the middle of the leaf.
I shift an inch more.
The leaf moved.
A shadow fell.
I flatten myself.
I edge backward bit by bit.
I look for the underside.
I pull my head in.
I have not moved a millimetre.
That shadow is too big.
I press against the vein.
I turn slowly the other way.
It has not left.
I wait for it to pass.
I lie perfectly still.
My colour hides me.
It has not seen me.
I shift half an inch.
The leaf rustles and I freeze.
I tuck beside the vein.
It has moved under the leaf.
I wait for it to go.
My legs are drawn under me.
There is not even wind.
It has come back around.
I press close a little longer.
I bunt it with my body.
I draw my head into the fold.
I bite once.
I thrash my body.
I roll off the leaf.
I cling to the vein.
I crawl back.
I hide in the leaf fold.
I have no strength left.
I curl up slowly.
I crawl out of the leaf gap.
A new shadow on the leaf.
The leaf rustles as I move.
I stop on the vein.
I have found a new leaf.

lines.zh: 我从露水里爬出，叶身还湿着。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dew, my leaf body still wet.
The leaf and I are one color.
I start gnawing the leaf edge.
I tuck into a small corner.
No one will notice me here.

lines.zh: 火烤干了叶子和我的身体
lines.en: Fire dries the leaf and me.

lines.zh: 叶虫离开了叶子，就掉下去。
lines.en: A leafid off its leaf simply falls.

lines.zh: 雨水泡软了我的叶身，我往下沉。
lines.en: Rain softens my leaf body, and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶面掀了下去。
lines.en: The shock wave blows me off the leaf.
Something grazes my body.

lines.zh: 紫光一照，我整只卷成一小团。
lines.en: Violet light hits, and I curl into a tiny ball.
Without leaves I cannot live.

lines.zh: 雷光从叶子缝里照下来
lines.en: Lightning shows through the leaves.
The leaf is gone; I fall.
